scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('public',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','public',{recursive:true});"
scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('public',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','public',{recursive:true});"
